text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Cream beige fine horizontal striped crewneck sweater over white pointed collar shirt, chocolate brown wide-leg trousers, brown shoes.. Add ONLY these accessories: A narrow plain black necktie, tied neatly at the shirt collar.; A silver trouser key chain with hook, short linked chain, key-shaped metal charms and a narrow brown leather tassel, shown detached as one accessory.; A medium dark brown soft leather handbag with two short rounded handles and slightly slouchy body.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Edit this exact outfit product image. Preserve every garment, color, cut, shoes, bag and trouser chain and white background. Fix ONLY the necktie: it must be ONE black necktie tied neatly with a single small knot centered beneath the white shirt collar. No two separate dangling strips or two ties. The tie's long tail is tucked UNDER the crewneck sweater and completely hidden; only the small knot and very short upper triangle above the sweater neckline are visible. Keep hollow empty garments, no skin, head, body or mannequin. Full outfit uncropped.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
